notes.title: Demo Now out!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675806/08ebf5b241f9e4a9f6fdbfdb2392ae3ede3706cb.png"][/img][/p][h1]Demo Release![/h1][p][/p][h3]We are excited to launch the Demo Version of the upcoming adventure, BUNNIMON.[/h3][p][/p][p]This demo version will allow you to experience what is coming later in the full version of the game. Tasked with helping Azure escape from the confines of the Pocket Prison, you'll need to use your wits, combined with a unique storytelling perspective to help her escape.[/p][p][/p][p]There is so much more coming in the full version of BUNNIMON that is currently under development, due for release at a later date. [/p][p][/p][p]Want to help shape the game in the future? Leave us your feedback on the Community Hub, and we will take it into account.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Until then, we hope you enjoy this Demo and we look forward to continuing the story soon![/b][/p]
